newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgiums's Recticel steps up presence in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Belgiums's Recticel steps up presence in Poland.

text.p: Belgian foam and foam products maker Recticel said its Eurofoam venture bought the remaining 22 percent of the shares in Polopren from the Polish state.
Polopren is one of the most important Polish producers of polyurethane foam for the seating and upholstery business and for technical foams, Recticel said in a statement.
At the same time Polopren bought 100 percent of the shares in Polymer Spzoo of Gdansk, northern Poland, one of the country's smaller foam producers.
Recticel said the acquistion fitted in with the strategy of Eurofoam GmbH, a 50/50 joint venture with Austria's Greiner group, to assure a geographical spread of operations throughout Poland.
